protocol_provenance.amendment_reason: Freeze a deterministic source/trace/program/artifact-bound C2 evidence root so independent W10/W11 can reconstruct the same fresh downstream C2 certificate without arbitrary diagnostic-root choice.

candidate_object.authority_rule: Transported bindings are assertions only. W10/W11 independently rederive them before comparison. Certificate self-consistency is insufficient.

w10.role: Independently strict-parse candidate certificate; rerun frozen W7/W8; require exact source-derived program/artifact bytes; reconstruct fresh C2 W0 certificate; rerun qualified W5/W6; independently recompute C3 certificate_id.

w11.role: Independent duplicate-key/unknown-field parser, relation canonicalizer, C3/C2 commitment construction, W7/W8/W5/W6 orchestration and final candidate-certificate verification.

preserved_development_evidence.meaning: Initial W11 source failed the source-normalization gate before semantic execution; failure preserved.
Checkout-local gofmt diagnostic run demonstrated W11 compiled and W10/W11 baseline semantics converged; formatted bytes were then frozen back into source.
After freezing formatted W11 source, the still-old exact blob pin rejected implementation drift, demonstrating the pin gate operated as intended.
Source-clean W11, with no checkout mutation, passed gofmt/vet/build and converged with W10 on the full baseline chain.

hosted_adversarial_validation.workflow: K1 C3 refinement certificate C0 adversarial gate

strongest_falsification_controls.importance: A boundary-shrunk C2 artifact was first proven independently valid to W5/W6 as a smaller bounded capsule, yet W10/W11 rejected it because it was not the exact source-derived C3 lowering.

A behavior-equivalent but non-CBTNF C2 program with rebuilt valid C2 artifact was independently acceptable downstream, yet rejected by the C3 certificate lane because exact source-derived normalization was violated.
Artifact JSON reserialization remained semantically valid C2 after rebuilding its proof identity, but stale C3 exact-artifact binding was rejected.
Ordered trace reorder/duplication/deletion cannot be laundered through an unchanged K1 set; two same-K1-set source programs accept only their own freshly rebound certificates.
Evidence-engine absence, independent-checker disagreement, and pinned implementation drift all fail closed.

exact_chain_required_for_acceptance: Candidate certificate is strict-parsed but its transported facts are not trusted.
W7 and W8 rerun exact C3 source independently and must agree on source/semantic/graph/ordered-trace/projected-REALIZE/lowering facts.
Both independently generated C2 program and artifact byte vectors must be identical and must exactly equal the supplied byte vectors.
W10 and W11 independently construct a fresh deterministic C2 W0 certificate from rederived facts; no producer C2 certificate is accepted as input.
Qualified W5 and W6 independently reexecute exact C2 program/boundary and must accept the fresh certificate with identical REALIZE, target and certificate commitment.
Only after the evidence chain succeeds are candidate C3 certificate fields compared to rederived facts and c3 certificate_id independently recomputed.
W10 and W11 must converge; disagreement is fatal.
strongest_supported_science_claim: For the prospectively frozen C0 certificate attack inventory, two independently implemented certificate verifiers (Python W10 and Go W11) rederived every authority-relevant candidate binding from the exact C3 source through frozen independent W7/W8 execution and exact C2 lowering, independently reconstructed a fresh downstream C2 preservation certificate, and required qualified W5/W6 reexecution before accepting the candidate object. All 8 positive controls were accepted and all 38 precommitted negative/splice/scope/trace/identity/engine-drift cases failed closed. In stronger controls, alternative C2 objects that were independently valid to W5/W6 were still rejected when they were not the exact source-derived C3 lowering, showing that the candidate object binds refinement scope rather than merely wrapping a valid downstream C2 proof.
nonclaims: C0 is a falsification/science lane, not qualification or production authority.
W10/W11 are independent certificate checkers but still orchestrate software evidence engines; this is not a proof-assistant kernel or proof of universal W7/W8 correctness.
C0 does not bind arbitrary native programs, containers, cloud services, concurrency, ambient effects or unbounded liveness to MFST.
Passing the frozen attack inventory does not prove absence of all possible certificate or common-mode bugs.
The candidate certificate does not make ordered traces part of K1 semantics; ordered trace fidelity remains a pre-projection C3 refinement obligation.
next_gate: Run a qualification-oriented Q0 that freezes W10/W11 exact implementations, replays F0 + selected G1/R0 controls through the certificate object itself, adds independent certificate-object mutation generation, and then decides whether the deliberately narrow MFST-to-qualified-C2 certificate lane is mature enough for production proof-kind promotion.
